title: Support Assistant Pilot Evaluation
subtitle: Results of an eight-week pilot of a retrieval-based support assistant, scored against the manual baseline.
source: Illustrative figures. Not real client or engagement data.

summary.verdict: The pilot meets its accuracy bar and misses its latency bar. Proceed to a limited rollout once retrieval latency is fixed.
text: Answer accuracy beat the manual baseline on four of five ticket categories. Two high-severity findings concern stale source documents and slow retrieval on long threads.

blocks.p: Illustrative setup: 1,200 tickets across five categories were answered by the assistant and by the manual process. Two reviewers scored each answer against a rubric for correctness and completeness.

callout.title: Scoring
callout.text: Accuracy counts an answer as correct only when both reviewers agree. Disagreements (6%) were resolved by a third reviewer.

findings.title: Stale source documents cause wrong answers in Legacy
findings.text: The Legacy category is the only one where the assistant trails the baseline. Wrong answers cite documents last updated before the 2025 migration.

evidence.text: 21 of 38 wrong Legacy answers cite a document with a modified date older than 2025-06-01.

code.caption: Query used to count the stale citations (Illustrative).

findings.recommendation: Add a freshness filter and retire documents older than the migration.

findings.title: Retrieval latency misses the target on long threads
findings.text: Median latency is 4.1 s against a 3.0 s target; threads above 20 messages average 7.4 s.
findings.recommendation: Summarize long threads before retrieval and cache the summary.

findings.title: Reviewer disagreement is concentrated in Integrations
findings.text: Half of the 6% disagreement comes from the Integrations category, where the rubric does not say how to score partial answers.
findings.evidence: 72 disagreements in total, 36 of them in Integrations.
findings.recommendation: Extend the rubric with a partial-credit rule before the next round.

callout.title: Decision requested
callout.text: Approve a limited rollout to the Billing and Access queues, conditional on F-02 reaching the 3.0 s target.

recommendations.title: Fix retrieval latency on long threads
recommendations.text: Summarize before retrieval; re-run the latency benchmark.

recommendations.title: Retire stale documents
recommendations.text: Apply the freshness filter and review the Legacy corpus.

recommendations.title: Extend the scoring rubric
recommendations.text: Add the partial-credit rule and re-score Integrations.
